exposure: After implementation of the oxytocin checklist
Before implementation of the oxytocin checklist
Implementation of a newly developed oxytocin checklist
cohort: 400 women at term who underwent induction of labor
finding: Use of the oxytocin checklist was associated with decreases in tachysystole, cesarean births for concern about fetal status based on electronic fetal monitoring data, length of first stage labor, and maximum dose of oxytocin.
mod_finding: Use of the oxytocin checklist was associated with decreases in tachysystole, cesarean births for concern about fetal status based on electronic fetal monitoring data, length of first stage labor, and maximum dose of oxytocin.
